Dana Ruiz: Quick heads-up  we need a short "health + ask" slide for Eastlake QBR on Thu 5/2 9am PT. Execs want 3 bullets max.
Owen Park: On it. I'll do feature adoption + NPS snippet. Where's the latest adoption table?
Maya Chen: `gs://redwood-qbr/eastlake/metrics.csv` has the uptake numbers through Apr 20. Use column `active_users_30d`.
Ravi Kapoor: I'll draft the renewal risk slide and call out the two accounts with reduced usage. Short mitigation plan: training + 1:1 workshop.
qbr-bot: Reminder: Upload slides 24h before QBR or they won't be included in the exec packet.
Dana Ruiz: Can someone grab a customer quote for the social proof slide? AE Sam is back tomorrow, @Ravi maybe ping him?
Ravi Kapoor: Will ping Sam and add quote if we get it. Also flagging onboarding checklist gaps: missing onboarding workshop 2 and no success plan.
Owen Park: Draft uploaded to GDrive: `eastlake_qbr_v0.pptx`. I added speaker notes and the NPS small chart. Please keep numbers rounded.
Maya Chen: Added a one-line note about the latency regression on March 31. Not an ask for execs but FYI.
Dana Ruiz: Action items: Owen finalize slides by Wed noon; Ravi confirm AE quote and finalize risk slide; Maya confirm metrics table and sanity check numbers; Dana compile exec packet Wed 2pm.
Ravi Kapoor: Quote in, pulled from AE slack DM: "Redwood helped us cut response times by half in the pilot." Adding to slide 4.
Owen Park: Final slides uploaded v0.3. All good for dry-run Wed 3pm. :thumbsup:
Dana Ruiz: Thanks team. I'll post the final packet link in this thread once compiled. If anything changes ping me.
